title: Subscription Audit & Cancel Kit: Subscription Tracker Spreadsheet, Yearly Bill, Renewal Dates and Cancel Scripts, Excel and Google Sheets
description:
See every subscription as one yearly bill, then cancel the ones you don't use. Subscription Audit & Cancel Kit turns scattered monthly charges into one clear number for Excel and Google Sheets.

What it does for you:
• Yearly bill: weekly, monthly and yearly prices added up for a whole year
• Unused flags: anything you haven't opened in 30 days (you pick the window) is flagged
• Renewal alerts: what renews in the next few days, with a cancel-by date
• Decisions: Keep, Cancel, Pause, Downgrade or Decide later, and what each one is worth a year
• Your 5 biggest subscriptions and a by-category breakdown
• Cancel scripts: pick a subscription and the email, chat and phone messages fill themselves in
• Find Them: 12 places subscriptions hide, from app stores to free trials, with a tick list
• Ask AI: 3 prompts built from your list (never account numbers) for the AI chat you already use

What's in the download:
• 2 spreadsheets: a Sample file with made-up data and a Blank file for yours
• A 3-page PDF: quick start, a printable checklist and audit sheet, and all 7 scripts

Good to know:
• Works in Microsoft 365, Excel 2019 or newer and Google Sheets
• Any currency: $, €, £, ₹ or your own symbol
• No bank login: you type your numbers and the sheet does the math
• It doesn't cancel anything for you. The scripts are polite starting points, not legal advice
• Made with AI assistance, then built and checked by hand
• Digital download, nothing ships

From Hourback, a Steadfold studio.
